body:
Adds a "Powered by Algolia" link in the _SearchBox_ widget.
It's currently disabled by default, but can be enabled with `poweredBy: true`.

![Preview](http://i.imgur.com/IcrxLom.png)

Closes #92 .

comments.body: Is this the retina logo? We can default to retina I guess.
Cool contribution I like it, some comments to fix/respond and we're good.

@vvo 

It's not real retina since I'm using `height: 1.4em`, so there is no guarantee on the actual height, but to be safe I've put an image of 32px height. If you want, I can enforce the height of the `img` to 16px in order to be sure to have the good aspect ratio.
Ok I get it, we just need to make sure that it's not blurry on our screens
If we agree on the default behavior (false) then we are good here. @Jerskouille can you now rebase into a single commit? `feat(searchBox): add poweredBy option, disabled by default` :dancer:

title: feat: poweredBy in SearchBox
